QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_48

question.text: Mean ± 2σ captures approximately what percentage of observations?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** ±2σ captures ~95% of normally-distributed observations. **The Trap:** 68% is ±1σ; 99.7% is ±3σ. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same empirical rule across exams. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Use ±2σ as a 'most-of-the-time' range when discussing expected drawdowns.
